summary: Whether you show it or not, a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you draw people in and know what you want, you reach, grow, and lift the room. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: Whether you show it or not, a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you draw people in and know what you want, you reach, grow, and lift the room. It rewards you when you reach for it. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
gift: At your best: you draw people in and know what you want, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it — or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let love and values and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you draw people in and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
